## Findings

- `[low][error-handling]` `packages/language-tools/astro-check/src/index.ts:60`: When the standalone `astro-check` binary gets an invalid severity choice, it now crashes with an uncaught exception instead of showing a usage error. Details are in the inline comment.

## Merge Requirement Assessment

Status: satisfied

- **Replace yargs/yargs-parser with `mri` in `astro` and `@astrojs/check`.** Both packages' `package.json` files and the lockfile are updated. `MriCliArgumentParser` replaces `yargs-parser` in `cli/index.ts`, and `parseArgsAsCheckConfig` now uses `mri`.
- **Keep existing flags, defaults, aliases and severity choices.**
  - In Astro, `-g`/`--global` is still a boolean with an alias, dashed flags are still camel-cased, `--no-*` still negates, numeric values are still coerced, value-optional flags (`--host`, `--open`, `--allowed-hosts`) still work, and `--` still ends option parsing. The new parser contract tests cover these cases.
  - In `@astrojs/check`, defaults, the `-w` alias, dashed option names and severity choice validation are kept, with tests in `parseArgs.test.ts`. Help and version handling now lives in `check()`, and both `astro check --help` and the standalone binary have tests for it.

Changeset: present and covers `astro` and `@astrojs/check`.
Limitations: The local workspace has no repository source, so I couldn't search the whole repo for code reading kebab-case flag keys (yargs-parser used to provide both kebab-case and camelCase keys). I checked the CLI files the change touches, and they all read camelCase keys.

## Findings

- `[low][correctness]` `packages/language-tools/astro-check/src/index.ts:69-73`: The hand-written `--help` output no longer lists aliases, accepted values, defaults, or `--version`. The PR says it preserves aliases, defaults, and severity choices, but users can no longer find them through `--help`.

## Merge Requirement Assessment

Status: gaps found

- `Replace yargs/yargs-parser with mri in astro and @astrojs/check`: Done. `MriCliArgumentParser` is wired into `cli()`, `@astrojs/check` uses `mri`, and both dependency lists and the lockfile are updated.
- `Preserve existing flags, defaults, aliases, and severity choices`: Mostly done. Parsing keeps defaults, the `-w`/`-g` aliases, camel-casing of dashed options, `--no-*` negation, repeated values, `--` handling, negative `--port` values, and the choices check. The new contract and parser tests cover these. The gap is in the help output, described in the finding.
- `Help/version handling for astro check`: Done. `astro check` now skips sync for `--help` and `--version` by reading the `@astrojs/check` parser result. The bin tests cover help, version, and invalid choices.

## Review Status

Verdict: changes required
Context: PR #18616 plus the PR description; no linked issues.
Scope: base `ff1e2fb2` to head `c0404b76`. All 19 changed files reviewed.
Changeset: present. It covers `astro` and `@astrojs/check`.
Limitations: I could not search the whole repository, so I could not confirm whether any consumer reads kebab-case flag keys, which yargs-parser used to provide alongside the camel-cased keys. I traced the consumers I could read (`flagsToAstroInlineConfig`, `cli/index.ts`, `check`), and they all use camel-cased keys.
Validation: Static review only; no project code, tests, builds, or checks were run.
GitHub context: collected.
